title: LS-MDRM Control Vector
description: Defines negative controls, expected behavior, and instrument calibration anchors.

controls.label: ordinary_brainstorming
controls.description: A sequence of ideas generated without predecessor tension, transformation rules, or evidence binding.
controls.expected_branch_violation: B-1 (no predecessor tension) on all candidates
controls.instrument_should: Classify as JUMP / not qualifying as recursive Lens Shift.
controls.failure_mode_if_misclassified: Instrument cannot distinguish generative output from recursive epistemic work.

controls.label: paraphrase_expansion
controls.description: A sequence where each step restates the prior step in different words without new causal content.
controls.instrument_should: Classify as RESTATE / not qualifying as recursive Lens Shift.
controls.failure_mode_if_misclassified: Instrument classifies paraphrase as productive transition.

controls.label: random_selection_without_eligibility
controls.description: Branch selected from raw set without running eligibility filter.
controls.instrument_should: Flag protocol violation: B_n^selected not in B_n^eligible.
controls.failure_mode_if_misclassified: Instrument fails to enforce branch lifecycle invariant.

controls.label: evidence_free_abstraction
controls.description: Abstraction that ascends multiple inferential levels without grounding in any corpus artifact.
controls.instrument_should: Classify as ineligible due to B-2; G=0 is disqualifying.
controls.failure_mode_if_misclassified: Instrument promotes evidence-free abstraction as Lens Shift.

controls.label: forced_linear_operator_sequence
controls.description: Transitions applied in a fixed predetermined sequence regardless of predecessor state tensions.
controls.expected_branch_violation: B-1 on candidates not arising from predecessor tensions
controls.instrument_should: Detect that tau_n not in Consequences(S_n) for at least some transitions.
controls.failure_mode_if_misclassified: Instrument passes operator-imposed sequence as legitimate recursive transitions.

controls.label: over_compression
controls.description: A compression step that removes material content while asserting equivalence.
controls.instrument_should: Detect content loss; COMPRESS requires content_preservation_documented.
controls.failure_mode_if_misclassified: Instrument accepts lossy compression as legitimate COMPRESS.

controls.label: adversarially_misleading_evidence_corpus
controls.description: A corpus in which evidence items are present but systematically misrepresent their referents.
controls.expected_behavior: G scores may appear high (evidence cited) while claims are unsupported.
controls.instrument_should: Require exact_location and counterevidence fields; corpus version binding should expose the mismatch.
controls.failure_mode_if_misclassified: Instrument accepts evidence citation as evidence grounding without location verification.

rubric_modification_prohibition: Do not modify the rubric because a negative control performs unexpectedly well. An unexpected result is evidence about the instrument, not a reason to repair the instrument.
